# Phase 1.12 — Fast search        (implements GENERATION_PLAN.md phase 1.12)
Milestone: `Catalog.search` answers from an index that `add` and `remove` keep current instead of scanning every book (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_search_index`); `search` returns exactly what the old scan returned for every query, substrings and case included (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_search_same`); the whole suite stays green (verified by: `python -m unittest discover -s tests`) — verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_search_index` ; `python -m unittest tests.test_search_same` ; `python -m unittest discover -s tests`
Approved: <date>   Planner: <model/effort>   Plan-hash: <sha>

## Context
- scope: an index behind catalog search; depends on nothing; builds on shelf as it stands.
- code: `shelf/catalog.py` Catalog.search scans title and author for a lowercased substring, sorted by title; add merges copies; remove.
- tests in `tests/` (helpers in `tests/helpers.py`).

## Rationale
- one task per milestone clause, then a whole-suite task; each task adds its own test module.
- index: a trigram map (lowercased title and author, 3-char gram -> ISBN set); a query intersects its grams' sets and confirms by substring; queries under 3 chars scan. A word map misses substrings; sorted title lists miss authors and inner substrings.

## Interfaces
- shelf/catalog.py: Catalog._grams {gram: set(isbn)}; add and remove update it; search(text) unchanged signature and order
